key_concepts: Dobereiner's Law of Triads groups three elements with similar properties
In a triad, the middle element's atomic mass is approximately the average of the other two
Calcium, strontium, and barium form a triad with average mass 88.7 close to strontium's 87
The Law of Triads had limitations and only about five triads were identified
Newlands' Law of Octaves states similar properties repeat every eighth element when arrang
Lithium and sodium share similar physical properties such as softness, silvery-white color
Mendeleev arranged elements by atomic mass and observed recurring periodic patterns
The periodic law provided a framework for organizing elements and predicting behavior
The modern periodic law arranges elements by atomic number rather than atomic mass
The periodic table is organized into 7 periods and 18 groups based on atomic structure and
Elements in the same group have the same number of valence electrons
Electron structure determines an element's position in the periodic table
